controversy_hook.primary_harm_thesis: dilution of local constituent voice via concentrated ideological/outside Super PAC bundlers

vote.question: Community Accountability Resolution [US-OR U.S. Senate]: Jeffrey Alan Merkley (D) has received $20,180,850 in career campaign contributions (with $5,376,935 this cycle, anchored by ACTBLUE ($541,977))—out-raising general opponent David Brock Smith ($311,174) by 17.28x—linked to "Outside Super PAC & Megadonor Swarm". Should OR release the community fund to local charities working on non-partisan civic accountability, investigative public-interest journalism, and voter legal defense?
vote.futarchy_thesis: Large campaign contributions create public concern over policy priorities. When Jeffrey Alan Merkley receives $20,180,850 (with $5,376,935 this cycle, anchored by ACTBLUE ($541,977)), community members want accountability. This fund lets residents decide whether to direct community resources to local public causes.

question_vars.lead_patron_clause: with $5,376,935 this cycle, anchored by ACTBLUE ($541,977)

options: Yes — Send Fund to Local Charities
No — Send Fund to Essential Community Services

outcomes.YES_RELEASE_TO_LOCAL_CHARITIES: Directs 100% of the funds to verified local non-profits working directly on state community needs.
outcomes.NO_RELEASE_TO_COMMUNITY_COMMONS: Directs 100% of the funds to bipartisan, universal local public services (volunteer fire/EMS, veterans' care, food banks, disaster relief).
outcomes.ABSTAIN_LOG_DISSENT: Records resident feedback without moving the vote count.

futarchy_pole_mechanics.leverage_ratio_statement: Every contribution directly empowers community-led funding. Once the campaign pool reaches $10,000, an automatic 60-day countdown begins. When the 60 days expire, all funds go directly to verified local charities or essential community services—zero platform cut.

bounty_if_passed.description: Community Fund for US-OR: Delivers 100% of funds to verified, IRS-registered 501(c)(3) public charities serving OR dedicated to non-partisan civic accountability, investigative public-interest journalism, and voter legal defense. Verified local recipients: LEGAL AID SERVICES OF OREGON (US-EIN:930635480); PUBLIC DEFENDER SERVICES OF LANE COUNTY INC (US-EIN:930684495); DISABILITY RIGHTS OREGON (US-EIN:930686170); PUBLIC DEFENDER OF MARION COUNTYINC (US-EIN:205797920); OREGON PUBLIC BROADCASTING (US-EIN:930814638). Once the pool hits $10,000, a 60-day timer starts. If YES wins, funds go to these charities; if NO wins, funds go to local community commons (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
bounty_if_passed.destination_criteria: All recipient organizations must be active, verified 501(c)(3) public charities registered in US-OR with clean IRS status and direct community impact. Approved charities: LEGAL AID SERVICES OF OREGON (US-EIN:930635480); PUBLIC DEFENDER SERVICES OF LANE COUNTY INC (US-EIN:930684495); DISABILITY RIGHTS OREGON (US-EIN:930686170); PUBLIC DEFENDER OF MARION COUNTYINC (US-EIN:205797920); OREGON PUBLIC BROADCASTING (US-EIN:930814638).

trigger_conditions: Condition 1 (Activation): The campaign activates its 60-day countdown timer as soon as total contributions reach $10,000 USD (Base USDC).
Condition 2 (Resolution Period): The community vote runs for exactly 60 days from the moment the $10,000 threshold is reached.

Condition 3 (Payout): If YES receives 60% or more of votes, 100% of the funds are sent to the verified state non-profits; otherwise, 100% is sent to universal community services (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
